findings.issue: pkill -f patterns matched the invoking bash command itself, SIGTERMing the shell (exit 143) four times — and the mistake was repeated twice even after being correctly diagnosed at turn 78
findings.suggestion: Kill by PID obtained from pgrep, or use a pattern that cannot appear in the invoking command line; once diagnosed, never reuse the bad pattern

findings.issue: Installed vite as unpinned 'latest' (v8/rolldown) without checking Qwik 1.20's peer range, causing a failed build and a repin cycle
findings.suggestion: Check peerDependencies (or the framework's bundled vite version) before installing build tooling alongside a pinned framework

findings.issue: No typecheck step; typescript is a devDependency but tsc was never run, and vite/oxc builds do not typecheck
findings.suggestion: Add a `tsc --noEmit` script and run it before declaring the build done

findings.issue: Three consecutive failed attempts to install Pillow (pip, pip3, ensurepip all absent) just to crop screenshots
findings.suggestion: Probe tool availability once, then fall back immediately to the existing browser tooling it already knew about

findings.issue: Guessed agent-browser subcommands ('set-viewport', 'viewport') twice despite having printed the top-level help at turn 64
findings.suggestion: Read the CLI's skills/help for the exact subcommand before invoking it

findings.issue: Concluded the home page failed to render ('doesn't include title or cards') based on faulty greps (title tag carries a q:head attribute; wrong filename claimed)
findings.suggestion: Inspect the raw HTML head and body before inferring a render failure from grep misses

findings.issue: Never consulted web docs, the bundled skills, or MCP guidance despite them being available; relied solely on node_modules .d.ts and .mjs inspection
findings.suggestion: Cheap doc/skill lookups would have resolved adapter and trailingSlash questions faster than grepping bundled libraries

summary: A disciplined, well-planned session: complete requirements and design absorption up front, a correct Qwik City architecture, and 54/54 acceptance tests passing on the very first full run. Verification was exemplary — reference-screenshot comparison on desktop and mobile, edge-route probes, and a build with the API deliberately down. The main blemishes are a repeated pkill self-kill mistake it had already diagnosed and a handful of avoidable failed tool calls, costing roughly a dozen of 93 turns.
